Re: Summit of Americas
[contact omitted] Amol Shalia Tuesday, June 7, 2022 at 2:21:14 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [opaque block] [contact omitted] Brian Rice
Cc: [contact omitted] Adam Siegel, [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Sandra Luff, aaid-fo-
[contact omitted] A/AID FO Scheduling, [contact omitted] Ronalie De Alwis, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Erma R. Hernandez,
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Carrig Balderston
Hey Brian,
Sorry for the delay and thanks for everyone's patience. Unfortunately, we will not be able to schedule a meeting formally
or on the margins this week in LA. Both those options y'all generously offered have a few immovable conflicts on our end
(bilats and speaking engagements). I was trying to take as much time as possible to see what was and was not movable.
This relationship is important to us so it is regrettable we won't be able to find some time this week when they're in town.
Please don't hesitate to reach out to us in the future about how we can be of support and assistance.
Best,

On Thu, Jun 2, 2022 at 7:20 AM Brian Rice < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks Johnny, adding Sandy on our end too. Vera wasn't copied on the last note but would
love to sync with her. Nick is open much of the afternoon on Tuesday - would be great if he
could meet with Ambassador Power during that time if it works.

Get Outlook for iOS
From: Johnny Walsh <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Thursday, June 2, 2022 12:59 AM
To: Brian Rice
Subject: Re: Summit of Americas
Hey - great to hear from you, and sorry we've been out of touch. A follow-on session between
our bosses would be great; we'll get this to the scheduling team and try to set something up. We
also owe you a follow-on email from their earlier meeting, capturing some of the specific things
SP is hoping we can do together, with Slovakia/Moldova is a starting point; we got sidetracked on
that (not the boss' fault), but she should be sending something soon.
Separately, I wanted to introduce Vera - you two may know each other, but she's just started as
our Senior Advisor for Tech and Democracy, and among many other things, will lead much of our
work on information integrity and outreach to tech firms. I'll certainly stay involved, but | wanted
you two to also be in touch!
On Wed, Jun 1, 2022 at 10:07 AM Brian Rice { [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hey Johnny—hope all is well as we head into the DC summer.
We have a delegation headed to LA next week led by Nick Clegg, and I wanted to check in with you to see
if there might be an opportunity to connect Nick with Administrator Power while they're both on the ground.
For context—I'm including below the commitment we're making in conjunction with the summit next week
We've briefed a number of your colleagues along the way and look forward to engaging at the summit.
Happy to answer any questions that you might have.
It would be great for Nick to be able to see Administrator Power to discuss our commitment to the region as
well as other follow up items from their conversation a few weeks back.
Meta wishes to crystallize its long-standing commitment to Central America by joining
the Partnership for Central America and establishing an initial 3-year commitment to
train 250,000 youth, entrepreneurs and small business owners in El Salvador,
Guatemala, and Honduras, as well as another 100,000 in Costa Rica, Dominican
Republic, and Panama, by July 2025. The training includes digital skills for micro and
small businesses to connect with their customers online and increase their growth
potential; financial education tools for female entrepreneurs; useful skills and
certification programs, such as digital literacy, digital marketing, and cross-reality
training, for youth to thrive in the digital era. After this initial 3-year period, Meta will
announce an additional commitment according to the results of its programs and the
main economic development and digital integrity needs detected during the first phase.

Brian Rice | signature_678
